issues.text: The migration's raw SQL queries against site_settings/categories assume at least one row is always returned and index into [0] unguarded, so on the vast majority of existing sites (which never customized embed_category), the join returns zero rows and rake db:migrate aborts.
issues.zh: Migration 對 execute() 查詢結果沒有取空保護，在絕大多數既有站台上 rake db:migrate 會直接中止。

issues.text: The migration inserts old host settings via raw SQL that bypasses the model's before_validation normalization (stripping scheme/path), so any legacy host value that included a scheme (e.g. http://) will never match after migration, silently breaking embedding for those domains with no error.
issues.zh: Migration 以原始 SQL 寫入舊設定值，跳過了 model 的正規化，遷移後帶 scheme 的 host 永遠比對不到。

issues.text: The same migration deletes the source site_settings rows it just read, in the same irreversible migration, so if the broken/unnormalized insert happens, there is no way to recover the original configuration afterward.
issues.zh: 來源資料（舊 site_settings）在同一支 migration 裡被刪除，遷移一旦跑過就不可回頭、無法重跑或救回原始清單。

issues.text: The migration's INSERT statement interpolates the host string directly without quoting/escaping, so a value containing a single quote would break the SQL statement and abort the migration.
issues.zh: INSERT 語句用字串直接內插，沒有經過 quote，值裡有單引號就會讓 migration 中止。

issues.text: TopicEmbed.import's category now comes from the matched EmbeddableHost record, but Jobs::PollFeed (the RSS/Atom feed-import path) never goes through EmbeddableHost matching, so feed-imported topics silently fall into Uncategorized with no replacement for what the old embed_category setting used to provide.
issues.zh: RSS/Atom feed polling 匯入的主題會靜默掉進 uncategorized，舊的 embed_category 沒有替代路徑，因為 Jobs::PollFeed 沒有經過 EmbeddableHost 比對。

issues.text: record_for_host's SQL comparison lowercases the stored host but the Ruby-side host value passed in is not lowercased, so the allow-list comparison is asymmetric depending on the case an admin happened to type when saving a host.
issues.zh: record_for_host 只把 SQL 端轉小寫，Ruby 端沒有，允許清單比對大小寫不一致。

issues.text: The admin controller's update and destroy actions look up the record with .first (returning nil when not found) and then call methods on it directly, producing an unhandled 500 instead of a proper 404, unlike the existing PermalinksController pattern in the same codebase.
issues.zh: update / destroy 查無記錄時直接對 nil 操作，回 500 而不是 404。

issues.text: The before_validation callback calls sub! directly on self.host without a nil check, so submitting the form with no host field raises a NoMethodError (500) instead of a normal presence-validation error.
issues.zh: before_validation 對可能為 nil 的 host 直接呼叫 sub!，缺欄位時得到 500 而不是驗證錯誤。

issues.text: The two new controller specs only assert the class's inheritance relationship and exercise none of the actual create/update/destroy behavior, so none of the real bugs in those controllers (like the 500-on-missing-record and nil-host issues) are caught by tests.
issues.zh: 兩支新的 controller spec 只斷言繼承關係，沒有任何行為覆蓋。

issues.text: expandable_first_post? dropped a condition (embeddable_hosts presence) with no accompanying explanation of whether that's intentional, and the corresponding spec that claims to test 'is false if embeddable_host is blank' had its setup line deleted, so it now passes for an unrelated reason (embed_truncate defaulting to false) and doesn't actually verify the behavior its name describes.
issues.zh: expandable_first_post? 少了一個條件，而宣稱測試它的案例已經測不到任何東西，靠的是 embed_truncate 預設 false 而非真正的斷言對象。

issues.text: An entire 'save' code path (frontend saveChanges action, backend EmbeddingController#update, and its route) is dead code with no UI element that ever triggers it, since actual saving is done per-row by a different component.
issues.zh: 整條「儲存」路徑是死碼：前端 saveChanges action、後端 update、路由三者都沒有人用。

issues.text: Two new fabricator files have their contents swapped: category_fabricator.rb now contains the embeddable_host fabricator and embeddable_host_fabricator.rb contains all the category fabricators, though tests still pass because fabricators are loaded from the whole directory regardless of filename.
issues.zh: 兩個 fabricator 檔案的內容互換了：category_fabricator.rb 裡是 embeddable_host，embeddable_host_fabricator.rb 裡是全部的 category。

issues.text: A store test requests id 2 but asserts on data belonging to id 1, and this passes only because the test pretender's mock endpoint ignores the id parameter and always returns the first fixture record, so the test doesn't actually verify id-based lookup or per-record hydration.
issues.zh: store-test 的 find embedded 要求 id 2 卻斷言 id 1 的資料，只因為 pretender 忽略 id。

issues.text: The `hydrated || []` fallback in the new plural-hydration branch is unreachable dead code since Array#map always returns an array, which misleadingly suggests map might return a falsy value.
issues.zh: hydrated || [] 這個分支永遠走不到，因為 Array#map 一定回傳陣列，讓讀的人誤以為 map 可能回傳 falsy 值。

issues.text: The new plural-hydration branch handles lookup failures differently from the existing singular branch: it unconditionally assigns the hydrated array (which can contain undefined entries for records not found in the sideload) and deletes the original *_ids field, with no way to recover if hydration was incomplete.
issues.zh: 複數分支對解析失敗與 null 的處理與單數分支不一致：無條件把整個陣列指派上去並刪除原始 id，找不到的情況混入 undefined 且無法補救。

issues.text: The plural-hydration branch calls .map directly on the ids field, which throws an exception if the backend ever sends a null value for that field (e.g. "color_ids": null).
issues.zh: obj[k].map(...) 在後端送 color_ids: null 時會直接拋例外。

issues.text: type.replace('_', '-') only replaces the first underscore in a string, which currently works only because no existing model name has two underscores; it will silently break routing for any future model name with multiple underscores.
issues.zh: type.replace('_', '-') 只會替換第一個底線，之後有兩段底線的模型名稱會出問題。

issues.text: The host-format validation regex limits the TLD to 2-5 characters, rejecting valid modern TLDs like .software or multi-level ones like .museum, with no explanation to the admin of why the format is rejected.
issues.zh: host 格式驗證的正規表示式把 TLD 限制在 5 字元以內，example.software、a.b.museum 都會被拒絕。

issues.text: The same regex rejects the bare hostname 'localhost', blocking admins from registering a local development host for embedding.
issues.zh: host 格式驗證的正規表示式無法通過 localhost，開發環境要嵌入本機服務時會卡住。

issues.text: The regex uses \Z (allows a trailing newline) instead of \z (strict end of string).
issues.zh: 正規表示式結尾用 \Z 而不是 \z，允許字串尾端多一個換行。

issues.text: The regex still permits an optional path segment and an optional port, but both are meaningless: before_validation already strips any path before validation runs, and record_for_host's comparison against URI(...).host never includes a port, so a saved host with a port can never actually match.
issues.zh: 正規表示式的路徑分支是死的（before_validation 已先剝掉路徑），port 分支也沒用（record_for_host 比對不含 port，存了帶 port 的 host 永遠比對不到）。

issues.text: The embeddable_hosts table has no unique constraint on host, so the admin UI can silently add the same domain twice, and record_for_host's .first makes it nondeterministic which category actually applies.
issues.zh: embeddable_hosts.host 沒有唯一性約束，後台可以重複新增同一個網域，record_for_host 用 .first，生效的是哪一筆取決於資料庫回傳順序。

issues.text: Two new controllers each redundantly redeclare before_filter :ensure_logged_in, :ensure_staff even though their parent Admin::AdminController already declares the same filters, so every request runs them twice.
issues.zh: 兩支新 controller 都重複宣告父類別已有的 before_filter :ensure_logged_in, :ensure_staff。

issues.text: Two new serializers redundantly define reader methods (id, host, category_id) that duplicate what the attributes declaration already auto-generates.
issues.zh: 兩個新 serializer 重複定義 attributes 已經產生的 reader 方法。

issues.text: resources :embeddable_hosts is declared without an only: restriction, generating four routes (index/show/new/edit) with no corresponding controller actions, so rake routes reports endpoints that don't actually exist.
issues.zh: resources :embeddable_hosts 開出了四條沒有對應 action 的路由。

issues.text: A newly-added i18n key (admin.embedding.edit) is never referenced by any template or JS file.
issues.zh: 殘留未使用的 i18n key admin.embedding.edit。

issues.text: A spec `let` block is left over with no remaining reference after the related SiteSetting usages were removed from the same file in this diff.
issues.zh: spec/controllers/embed_controller_spec.rb 的 let(:host) 在這份 diff 之後已經沒有任何引用。

issues.text: The component's delete action has no error handling on its promise chain, unlike the save action in the same file which uses popupAjaxError, so a failed delete (e.g. record already gone) leaves the row silently still on screen with no feedback to the user.
issues.zh: component 的 delete 分支沒有錯誤處理，與同檔 save 分支使用 popupAjaxError 的做法不一致，刪除失敗時使用者沒有任何提示。

issues.text: edit() reads host.category.id, which can be undefined if the sideloaded category wasn't hydrated correctly, causing a save to silently default the category to Uncategorized with no visible indication to the admin that the category changed.
issues.zh: edit() 讀的是 host.category.id，若 sideload 沒有帶回對應 category，categoryId 會是 undefined，儲存時後端會靜默套用 uncategorized。

open_questions.text: Does the existing embed_category site setting on real sites store a category name or a category id, since the migration's join assumes it's a name but the consumer code supports both?
open_questions.zh: 既有站台的 embed_category 設定值存的是分類「名稱」還是分類 id？

open_questions.text: Does the new admin/customize/embedding screen actually work end-to-end, given every layer checks out statically but none of it has been run (no gems, no node_modules, no acceptance test)?
open_questions.zh: 新的 admin/customize/embedding 畫面實際上跑得起來嗎？
